question.text: REIT minimum public float (post listing) under SEBI REIT Regulations:

answer.text: At least 25% public holding post listing

explanation.text: **The Logic:** SEBI mandates at least 25% public holding. **The Trap:** Other percentages don't match regulation. **Cross-Exam Context:** Same in XI. **Distributor's Pro-Tip:** Check public float and sponsor stake before recommending REIT IPOs.
